# The Legend of the Jackalope Sample

Illustrated in black pen and ink old engraving style. White background. Available in prepasted smooth wallpaper - our recommended pick for a seamless, professional-grade finish that's still fully removable - as well as peel-and-stick for a quick, no-water install, permanent wallpaper for the long haul, or Type II commercial-grade wallpaper for high-traffic spaces. Every option is GreenGuard Gold certified and printed with child-safe, non-toxic inks.
